content:
While the Labor Day sales are over now, Amazon is still offering holiday deal pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and it has brought back all-time lows on AirTag 2 at $20 each. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the very first discount on the brand new M5 Max Mac Studio ahead of delivery this month, alongside the ongoing deals on the new M6 Mac mini. We also have a return all-time low on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display at $100 off and this base model 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at the best price in months ($150 off). Everything else awaits below.

Labor Day is over, but you can still land holiday deal pricing on AirPods Pro 3 if you’re quick

The official Labor Day sales are over now, but Amazon is still offering the holiday deal pricing on AirPods Pro 3 down at $50 off – this isn’t likely to last for much longer.

As of the time writing, Amazon is currently offering Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped.

Regularly $249, this is $50 off of the list price and one of the more notable hangover Labor Day deals.

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Amazon just brought back the holiday all-time low on AirTag 2 at $20 each

After jumping back up to full price just before the major Labor Day sales ended late last night, Amazon has decided to bring back all-time low pricing on the 2026 AirTag 2 starting from $20 a pop.

While Amazon kept is Labor Day holiday pricing on AirPods Pro 3 live though the night and into this morning, the particularly notable all-time low on the 4-pack of Apple’s AirTag 2 jumped back up to full price as expected.

As of the this morning though, Amazon has decided to bring back the holiday deal on the 4-pack at $79.99 shipped. Regularly $99, this is nearly 20% off and marking a return of the best deal we have tracked on Apple’s latest trackers to date.

The single listing is still down at $24 Prime shipped right now, which is also the best deal we have tracked for just one of them.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

First discount hits Apple’s new M5 Max Mac Studio ahead of delivery this month

Alongside the ongoing pre-order discounts on the new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini, we are also now tracking the very first discount on Apple’s brand new M5 Max Mac Studio ahead of delivery this month.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio down at $2,449.99 shipped.

This is a regularly $2,499 configuration and Amazon is now delivering the very first chance to score some pre-order savings before it even releases at nearly $50 off.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,670 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (Reg. $2,499)

Set to deliver starting on September 22 alongside the new Mac mini lineup, this is the “Brawn of a new age” – Apple’s latest Mac Studio model housing the M5 Max chip.

The configuration we have on sale and featured here today is the base and most affordable setup with the 18-Core/32-Core internals, 36GB of RAM, and the 512GB internal storage capacity.

The $49 off certainly isn’t a massive deal considering the price here, but a deal is a deal and this is a brand new Mac that hasn’t even released yet – you might as well keep some cash in your pocket and score it from Amazon if you’re still looking to land a pre-order instead of paying full price at Apple.

Most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display returns to Amazon all-time low at $100 off

We caught some notable Amazon all-time lows on Apple’s latest 2026 Studio display lineup for Labor Day last week, but they were largely only on the more expensive configurations. Today at Amazon however, we are getting a return all-time low on the most affordable model you can buy at $100 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display with the standard glass and the Tilt-Adjustable Stand down at $1,499 shipped.

This model with the Tilt-Adjustable Stand carries a $1,599 list price at Apple and elsewhere. Today’s deal knocks $100 off the list to deliver the best deal we can find.

You’re also looking at a return Amazon all-time low here. We saw this model dropping down to $1,499 a couple times shortly after release, but it has largely remained at closer to $1,550 since then.

This is still not exactly the most affordable display you can buy, that’s for sure. But if you are looking to upgrade to Apple’s 2026 Display tech, you are looking at the lowest price of entry we have tracked to date here again today.

Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air hits best price in months at $150 off

Amazon is now offering its best deal in months on the base model 15-inch M5 MacBook Air. You’ll now find the Midnight model sitting at $150 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $1,349 shipped. Only the Midnight model is down this low right now nd this is often times an indication the deal might not stick around for very long.

This is a regularly $1,499 configuration sitting at $150 under the price Apple and other authorized dealers will charge you.

You’re looking at the lowest price we have tracked on this configuration – the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air you can buy – since the price increases hit retail. It’s certainly not as low as it once was, but we are looking at the best deal in months here on one of the more affordable machines in the lineup.

As of right now, even the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store doesn’t have any MacBook Air models in stock.

Sony debuts updated ‘fan favorite 1000XM4′ headphones with more affordable new XM4C

Update: The new WH-1000XM4C Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones are now available for purchase directly from Sony and over at Amazon for $299.99. Delivery is set for between September 23 and October 1.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Score a 4K UHD workstation monitor for $200 while Samsung’s latest ViewFinity S7 is down to its all-time low
  • Originally $150 nuPhy Air75 wireless Mac mechanical keyboard is just $70 for Labor Day
  • Mice can be expensive, Acer’s affordable 6-button model with adjustable DPI is only $10 right now
  • This magnetic M.2 NVMe enclosure also doubles as a compact hub with SD/TF card readers, 100W PD, and more, now just $33
  • Woven Beats USB-C short cable keeps it neat and tidy down at $8 Prime shipped
  • One of the best Labor Day deals drops Lexar’s tiny 1TB SSD + USB-C hub bundle to its lowest price since the hikes at $100 off

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

We are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

The only configuration Amazon carries that isn’t seeing some kind of discount right now is the 24GB M6 model. While these deals are clearly not massive by any means, we are talking about brand new Apple gear here that hasn’t even released yet. And if you’re going to be pre-ordering one without a trade-in, you might as well save you a few bucks for gas, coffee, or just to scoop up some of those new Polishing Cloths while they are still available.

Be sure to dive into this week’s massive Labor Day sales at Amazon and Best Buy, and then scope out all of the latest details on Apple’s new M6 and M5 Pro releases below:

Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 now $100 off for Labor Day weekend

As part of its giant Labor Day weekend sale, and joining the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, Amazon is now offering $100 off the latest AirPods Max 2 in just about every color.

Amazon has just dropped the price on Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 starting from $449 shipped. Regularly $549, you’re looking at a solid $100 off the list price here.

As of the time of writing, all but the orange set is down in this range (or within $1).

  • AirPods 4 Amazon Resale $79 (Reg. $129)

With most colors having jumped back up closer to full price just ahead of the big Labor Day sales going live, we are now finally seeing some holiday pricing here. While certainly not the lowest we have ever tracked, today’s deal comes within $20 off the August summer sale and lands on par with the best we have tracked outside of the big June Prime Day price otherwise.

Apple’s Max 2 debuted earlier this year with the same Smart Case, paint jobs, and USB-C charging port as the previous release, but they now come powered by the H2 chip with “1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation,” alongside a new high dynamic range amplifier, Live Translation tech, Conversation Awareness, and Transparency mode.
